title: Non-archimedean and hybrid dynamics of regular polynomial automorphisms
summary: In this paper, we study the weak limit of the invariant measures attached to an analytic family $\{f_t\}_{t\in\mathbb{D}^*}$ of regular polynomial automorphisms over $\mathbb{C}^N$ parametrized by the unit punctured disk which may degenerate at the origin, by using the techniques called hybrid spaces developed by Boucksom--Favre--Jonsson. For each $t$, the invariant measure $μ_t$ is constructed by Sibony, and we show that the weak limit of $\{μ_t\}_t$ over the hybrid space is given by the invariant measure of the regular polynomial automorphism $f_{\mathbb{C}((t))}^{\operatorname{an}}$ over…
